fields.description: Save magic 'TANTEIQ', strcpy-written into the save struct by FUN_081daffc via FUN_08215b48 and mirrored to SRAM.
fields.evidence: FUN_081daffc calls FUN_08215b48 (*DAT_081db044, DAT_081db048) to strcpy the magic; SRAM bytes 0x00-0x06 read back via FUN_08215724 and written via FUN_082155ec; baseline.sav holds 54 41 4E 54 45 49 51.
fields.name: save_magic

fields.description: NUL terminator of the save magic, always written by the FUN_08215b48 strcpy in FUN_081daffc.
fields.evidence: FUN_08215b48 (strcpy) called from FUN_081daffc always stores the NUL; SRAM offset 0x07 is 0x00 in baseline.sav.
fields.name: magic_terminator

fields.description: Low validation stamp: ROM-table checksum computed by FUN_081db0a4 and stored at save-struct offset +8 by FUN_081daffc; mirrored to SRAM offset 0x08.
fields.evidence: FUN_081daffc stores FUN_081db0a4() result at (*DAT_081db044)+8; SRAM u16_le at 0x08 is 0x0218 in baseline.sav; transferred by FUN_08215724 / FUN_082155ec.
fields.name: rom_validation_stamp_lo

fields.description: Scenario-progress flag A: first nonzero gameplay byte in the live-captured save; exact bit meaning unresolved.
fields.evidence: Only nonzero gameplay byte region in live baseline.sav besides the stamps; SRAM offset 0x5B9 round-tripped 1:1 by FUN_08215724 (load, DAT_081db04c) and FUN_082155ec (save, DAT_081db890); bracketed by the FUN_081db0a4/FUN_081db0cc validation stamps.
fields.name: scenario_progress_flag_a

fields.description: Scenario-progress flag B: second nonzero gameplay byte in the live-captured save; exact bit meaning unresolved.
fields.evidence: Second nonzero gameplay byte in live baseline.sav (offset 0x5BC = 0x01); SRAM round-tripped 1:1 by FUN_08215724 (load, DAT_081db04c) and FUN_082155ec (save, DAT_081db890); bracketed by the FUN_081db0a4/FUN_081db0cc validation stamps.
fields.name: scenario_progress_flag_b

fields.description: High validation stamp: ROM-table checksum computed by FUN_081db0cc and stored at save-struct offset +0x610 by FUN_081daffc; mirrored to SRAM offset 0x610.
fields.evidence: FUN_081daffc stores FUN_081db0cc() result at (*DAT_081db044)+0x610; SRAM u32_le at 0x610 is 0xE3FFC232 in baseline.sav; transferred by FUN_08215724 / FUN_082155ec.
fields.name: rom_validation_stamp_hi
